purpose: Test whether target-free global observable context predicts the sign and amplitude of the dominant object-specific V65 sub-Mpc pair correction across simulation domains before introducing a nonlocal conditioning head.

response.source: the sealed V65 source_balanced control for the corresponding immutable train query
response.definition: arithmetic mean of the three signed natural-log predicted-pair-mean over truth-pair-mean ratios at 0.3125, 0.625, and 0.9375 Mpc/h
response.truth_use: response only; never a predictor, standardizer, feature selector, ridge-hyperparameter selector, stopping signal, or density-model input

ordered_blocks.name: sealed_observable_context
ordered_blocks.source: train cache observable_context_features for the query object

ordered_blocks.name: log_backbone_auto_power
ordered_blocks.source: mean-subtracted corrected backbone on the eight sealed V35 Fourier bands

ordered_blocks.name: log_count_auto_power
ordered_blocks.source: mean-subtracted raw galaxy-count input on the eight sealed V35 Fourier bands

ordered_blocks.name: log_radial_velocity_auto_power
ordered_blocks.source: mean-subtracted mean radial-velocity input on the eight sealed V35 Fourier bands

ordered_blocks.name: sealed_object_amplitude
ordered_blocks.source: V45 train conditioning cache target-free object_amplitude for the query object

fixed_probe.feature_standardization: within each training fold only; training mean and population standard deviation with values below 1e-12 replaced by one
fixed_probe.cross_validation: three leave-one-simulation-domain-out folds; train on 32 objects from two domains and predict all 16 objects in the held domain
fixed_probe.constant_reference: the mean response of the two training domains in the fold

per_held_domain: Ridge and constant-reference mean absolute error
pooled: RMSE and relative RMSE improvement over the foldwise constant reference

permutation_control.operation: independently permute the 16 responses within each domain, then repeat the identical three leave-one-domain-out ridge calculation
statistics: pooled relative RMSE improvement over the foldwise constant reference
permutation_control.one_sided_p_value: (one plus the number of permutation statistics at least the observed statistic) divided by 257

selection_rules.cross_domain_predictive: in every held domain Ridge RMSE is strictly below its constant reference, Pearson correlation is strictly positive, and sign accuracy is at least 0.625; pooled Pearson is at least 0.5 and pooled sign accuracy is at least two thirds
selection_rules.permutation_significant: both one-sided 256-replicate permutation p-values are at most 0.05
selection_rules.select_nonlocal_context_head: cross-domain predictability, permutation significance, exact feature/query/response provenance, numerical integrity, and all firewalls pass

authorized_if_selected.future_architecture_scope: a target-free 33-component global-context scalar head that modulates one nonlocal pair-correction direction
